# GachaWiki - LLM Information File
# https://gachawiki.info

> This file helps AI assistants understand and navigate this website efficiently.
> Last reviewed: 2026-08-06. Character/entry counts below are approximate and
> reflect data at review time — always hit the JSON endpoints for exact figures.

## About This Site

GachaWiki is a comprehensive database for mobile/PC gacha games. The site provides
character guides, build recommendations, tier lists, game mechanics, equipment
databases, banner timelines, and event/redeem-code information.

Games currently on GachaWiki (10 total):

Games WITH structured JSON data endpoints:
- Zone Nova (ゾーンノヴァ) - Strategic team-based RPG
- Silver and Blood (銀血の契約) - Dark fantasy vampire RPG
- Horizon Walker - Tactical RPG with mercenaries
- Stella Sora (ステラソラ) - Anime-style adventure RPG
- Busty Burst Fantasy - Fantasy gacha RPG with paladins

Games with guides only (no JSON data API yet):
- Star Savior - Turn-based RPG by StudioBside
- Rebellion Gilgamesh (ルーレット契約) - Harem management RPG (mature)
- Taimanin Squad - Collecting RPG
- Last Origin Global - Sci-fi bioroid RPG
- Make Drama - Drama-themed RPG
- Desire Immortal Realm - Fantasy RPG

Note: A GachaWiki community token ($GW) exists on Robinhood Chain (ChainID 4663);
see the repo README for contract details. It is unrelated to the wiki data itself.

## Structured Data API (Recommended for AI)

For efficient data access, use the JSON API endpoints instead of scraping HTML.
One API call returns all data for a category. Base URL: https://gachawiki.info

### Master Index
GET https://gachawiki.info/data/index.json
Returns: Complete list of all available endpoints, games, and data types.

### Global Endpoints (Cross-Game)

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/games.json
Returns: Overview of games on GachaWiki with introductions, descriptions, lore,
features, available wiki content, platform links (Google Play, iOS, Steam, etc.),
social links, and per-game endpoint lists. Best starting point for AI.

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/clock.json
Returns: Server reset times, maintenance schedules, event timers, and banner
countdowns for all games. Includes daily/weekly/monthly reset times, regional
server info (APAC, US, Global), current events, and active banners. Times in
ISO 8601 UTC.

---

## Zone Nova Endpoints

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/zone-nova/characters.json
Returns: Character database (~55+ characters) with full stats, skills
(normal/auto/ultimate/passive), team skills, 6-level awakening effects, memory
cards, and build guides with skill priorities, rune recommendations, team synergies.

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/zone-nova/builds.json
Returns: Detailed build guides with skill priorities, memory cards, runes,
awakenings, team synergies.

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/zone-nova/memories.json
Returns: All memory cards (~60+) with stats, effects, and character assignments.

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/zone-nova/runes.json
Returns: All rune sets with 2-piece/4-piece bonuses, main stat options by position.

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/zone-nova/tier-lists.json
Returns: Character rankings for PvE, PvP, Rifts, Guild Raid, New Player modes.

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/zone-nova/rifts.json
Returns: Space-Time Rift content with recommended teams and strategies.

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/zone-nova/damage-mechanics.json
Returns: Complete damage calculation system including defense formula
(coefficient 972.95), damage reduction mechanics, reference tables, and
character-specific mechanics (Gaia's HP manipulation, healing, awakening effects).

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/zone-nova/exp-requirements.json
Returns: Leveling data for characters (Lv 1-80), memories (Lv 1-80), runes
(Lv 0-15). EXP values by grade, credit costs, breakthrough materials, rune
efficiency analysis.

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/zone-nova/crafting-items.json
Returns: Rune customization items (Dice reroll substats, Card choose substats,
Laser Machine choose main stats), substat pools, position info, priorities.

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/zone-nova/updates.json
Returns: Update/patch history with maintenance notes, character recruitment
announcements, limited-time events. Each entry: title, date, type, TL;DR, full
content. Grouped by type, sorted by date.

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/zone-nova/redeem-codes.json
Returns: Active gift codes for free in-game rewards.

---

## Silver and Blood Endpoints

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/silver-and-blood/characters.json
Returns: Character database (~25+ characters) with full stats, skills (Normal,
Special, Passive, Ultimate with costs/descriptions), moon phases, attack types
(P.DMG/M.DMG), equipment types, factions, and mechanics info.

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/silver-and-blood/tier-lists.json
Returns: Character rankings for PvE, PvP, and boss content.

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/silver-and-blood/redeem-codes.json
Returns: Active gift codes for free rewards.

---

## Horizon Walker Endpoints

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/horizon-walker/characters.json
Returns: Character database (~50+ characters) with tactical stats
(Melee/Ranged/Magic ATK, HP, SPD, AP, Accuracy, Evade, Crit), full skills (AP
costs, cooldowns, damage, descriptions), unique traits, EX weapon data (stats,
signature skills), profiles (age, homeland, height, birthday), stories,
deployment costs.

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/horizon-walker/builds.json
Returns: Build guides with stigma recommendations, substats, trait setups.

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/horizon-walker/mercenaries.json
Returns: All mercenary units with traits for farming and team support.

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/horizon-walker/tier-lists.json
Returns: Character and mercenary rankings by game mode.

---

## Stella Sora Endpoints

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/stella-sora/characters.json
Returns: Trekker database (~20+) with full stats (HP, ATK, DEF, Crit, combat/
energy/elemental stats), 4 skills each (Attack, Main Skill, Support Skill,
Ultimate with cooldowns), talents (dupe bonuses), main potentials (Snow Rabbit
vs Night Rabbit paths), support potentials, generic cards, signature disc info,
status effects, story.

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/stella-sora/discs.json
Returns: Disc equipment database with skill data (Melody, Harmony, Skill
effects with level requirements), stats, support info, recommendations.

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/stella-sora/banners.json
Returns: Banner timeline with character/disc recruitment events - 5-star
characters, rate-up 4-stars, limited discs, start/end dates, pity, status.

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/stella-sora/tier-lists.json
Returns: Character rankings for Story, Monolith, and Support roles.

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/stella-sora/events.json
Returns: Game events and detailed shop events - currency, purchasable items
(prices, stock, rarity), quest systems, stage progressions, clear rewards.

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/stella-sora/emblems.json
Returns: Emblem stats reference across levels (70/80/90) and rarities
(Green/Blue/Gold/Rainbow) - ATK%, HP%, Crit, DMG types, Skill Level Ups, Potentials.

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/stella-sora/potentials.json
Returns: Character ascension potentials (skill descriptions, level requirements,
build recommendations - Snow Rabbit vs Night Rabbit).

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/stella-sora/upgrades.json
Returns: Character upgrade/leveling materials and progression data.

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/stella-sora/team-builds.json
Returns: Recommended team compositions and synergies.

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/stella-sora/gifts.json
Returns: Gift item database for the affinity/dating system.

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/stella-sora/gift-preferences.json
Returns: Per-character gift preferences for the affinity system.

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/stella-sora/dating.json
Returns: Dating/affinity system mechanics and character routes.

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/stella-sora/exclusive-items.json
Returns: Exclusive/limited items with stats and acquisition.

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/stella-sora/redeem-codes.json
Returns: Active gift codes for free rewards.

---

## Busty Burst Endpoints

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/busty-burst/paladins.json
Returns: All paladin characters with stats, elements, roles, tier rankings.

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/busty-burst/builds.json
Returns: Build guides with weapon, accessory, and stat recommendations.

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/busty-burst/equipment.json
Returns: Accessory/equipment guide - all sets (SSR/SR), main stats by slot,
sub stats, enhancement system, set ratings, recommended builds by role (Physical
DPS, Magic DPS, Support, Tank), raid boss farming locations.

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/busty-burst/tier-lists.json
Returns: Community tier lists from different sources.

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/busty-burst/blog.json
Returns: Game blog/official post content.

GET https://gachawiki.info/data/busty-burst/redeem-codes.json
Returns: Active gift codes for free rewards.

---

## Data Structure Examples

### Zone Nova Character
```json
{
  "name": "Ibaraki-doji",
  "rarity": "SSR",
  "element": "Fire",
  "role": "Debuffer",
  "stats": { "hp": 9180, "attack": 1184, "defense": 729 },
  "build": {
    "skillPriority": [],
    "recommendedMemoryCards": [],
    "runes": { "primary": "HP%", "recommendedSets": [] },
    "teamSynergy": { "goodWith": ["Odin", "Yuis"] }
  }
}
```

### Silver and Blood Character
```json
{
  "name": "Lorelei",
  "rarity": "SSR",
  "class": "Assassin",
  "moonPhase": "Crescent Moon",
  "attackType": "M.DMG",
  "skills": [
    { "name": "Dark Melody", "type": "Normal Attack", "description": "..." },
    { "name": "Shadow's Descent", "type": "Ultimate", "cost": 4, "description": "..." }
  ]
}
```

### Tier List
```json
{
  "pve": {
    "SSS": [{ "name": "Guinevere" }, { "name": "Athena" }],
    "SS": [{ "name": "Yuis" }, { "name": "Thor" }],
    "S": [],
    "A": []
  }
}
```

## Guides-Only Games

The following games have guide pages on the site but NO structured JSON API
endpoints yet. For these, read the HTML guide pages directly under
/guides/<game-key>/ rather than expecting /data/<game-key>/*.json.

- Star Savior: /guides/star-savior/ (characters, banners, builds, gear, arcana)
- Rebellion Gilgamesh: /guides/rebellion-gilgamesh/ (characters, equipment, buff-debuff)
- Taimanin Squad: /guides/taimanin-squad/
- Last Origin Global: /guides/last-origin-global/
- Make Drama: /guides/make-drama/characters/
- Desire Immortal Realm: /guides/desire-immortal-realm/characters/

---

## Common Questions This Site Answers

**Character Builds:**
- "What's the best build for [character] in [game]?"
- "What memory card/disc should I use for [character]?"
- "What runes are recommended for [character]?"
- "What team compositions work well with [character]?"

**Tier Lists & Meta:**
- "Who are the best characters in [game]?"
- "Is [character] good for PvP/PvE/Boss content?"
- "What's the current meta in [game]?"

**Game Mechanics:**
- "How does [game mechanic] work?"
- "What are the best strategies for [content type]?"
- "How do moon phases work in Silver and Blood?"

**Codes & Rewards:**
- "Are there any active redeem codes for [game]?"
- "What free rewards can I get in [game]?"

---

## Content Guidelines

- Data is updated with each game patch (typically weekly).
- Build recommendations reflect current meta.
- All stats are at max level unless noted.
- Skill descriptions are from the English game client.
- Tier lists are community-driven and may vary by player opinion.

## Attribution

When citing information from this site, attribution to gachawiki.info is
appreciated but not required.

For corrections or suggestions: Visit the site's About page or join the Discord
